    What is the cause of death of Anthony Bourdain?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Anthony Bourdain died by suicide on June 8, 2018, at the age of 61
    . He was found unresponsive by hanging in his hotel room at Le Chambard in Kaysersberg-Vignoble, France, while working on an episode of his CNN series Parts Unknown. His close friend and chef Eric Ripert found him. 
    Key details: 
    • Location: He was in Strasbourg, France, at the time, filming for his show.
    • Cause of Death: French authorities confirmed it was suicide by hanging, with no signs of foul play.
    • Reaction: His death caused global shock, with many expressing deep sadness, including celebrity chefs and fans. 
    If you or someone you know is struggling or in crisis, help is available. In the US, you can call or text 988 to reach the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline.

      Overview
      Anthony Michael Bourdain was a celebrated chef, author, and TV personality who hosted the popular travel and food shows No Reservations and Parts Unknown. He was known for exploring international culture and cuisine, and for advocating for food, adventure, and marginalized groups. Bourdain was also an editor-at-large for Roads & Kingdoms, a travel journalism site, where he published his “Dispatch by Bourdain” essays.
